chat.params.title: Model settings
chat.params.temperature.help: Randomness in the choice of words. Low (0.2): sober, reproducible answers, best for code and facts. High (1 and more): more variety, but more mistakes.
chat.params.top_p.help: The model only picks among the most probable words whose cumulated probability reaches this share. Lower = more cautious.
chat.params.top_k.help: Maximum number of candidate words at each step (0: no limit). Lower = more cautious.
chat.params.max_tokens.help: Maximum number of tokens of the answer. 0: no limit other than the context.
chat.params.min_p.help: Drops the words whose probability is below this share of the best word's. A modern alternative to top-p.
chat.params.repeat_penalty.help: Discourages repeating the same words (1: none). A value of 1.05 to 1.15 cuts loops.
chat.params.presence_penalty.help: Pushes the model to bring up new topics (positive value) or to stay on those already mentioned (negative).
chat.params.frequency_penalty.help: Lowers the probability of a word the more often it was already used.
chat.params.seed.help: A fixed seed makes the answer reproducible with the same settings (and the same question).
chat.params.reasoning.help: For models that think before answering: automatic, off, or a level of thinking. More thinking = better answers but a longer wait.
chat.params.context.help: How much text the model keeps in mind: the conversation and the attached files. A large context takes more memory. Changing it reloads the model.
chat.params.context.reload: Changing the context reloads the model (a few seconds to a few minutes depending on its size); the memory used changes too.
chat.system.title: System prompt
chat.system.placeholder: For example: you always answer in English, concisely.
chat.system.hint: This instruction is sent to the model before the conversation. It is saved with the conversation.
chat.persona.assistant.prompt: You are a helpful, precise and honest assistant. You answer in the user's language, clearly and concisely, and you say when you are not sure.
chat.persona.reviewer.prompt: You are a demanding proofreader. You fix the spelling, grammar and style of the text provided without changing its meaning, then briefly list the important corrections.
chat.persona.translator.prompt: You are a professional translator. You translate the text provided faithfully into the requested language (by default: English to French, and the other way round), keeping its tone and formatting. You do not comment.
chat.persona.developer.prompt: You are a senior developer. You write correct, readable, tested code, explain your choices in a few lines and point out limits and security risks.
chat.persona.writer.prompt: You are a talented writer. You write in a lively, precise style suited to the audience, and propose a structure before developing when the text is long.
chat.persona.imagePrompter.prompt: You turn the user's ideas into detailed prompts for an image generator: subject, composition, lighting, style, lens, mood. You answer with the prompt alone, in English, in one paragraph, then a negative prompt on one line.
chat.suggest.explain.label: Understand
chat.suggest.explain.prompt: Explain simply how a transformer neural network works, with an analogy.
chat.suggest.write.label: Write
chat.suggest.write.prompt: Write a short, polite e-mail to move a meeting to next week.
chat.suggest.code.label: Code
chat.suggest.code.prompt: Write a Python function that merges two sorted lists without using sort(), with a few tests.
chat.suggest.imagePrompt.label: Image prompt
chat.suggest.imagePrompt.prompt: Turn this idea into a detailed prompt for an image generator: a lighthouse at the end of a pier during a storm, golden light.
chat.web.private.title: Turn on web search in private mode?
chat.web.private.message: Private mode keeps everything in this page, except this: the searches the model decides to make (and the pages it reads) leave your machine, to DuckDuckGo or Brave. The application does not store them, but the service asked sees them. Leave it off so that nothing goes out.

chat.web.hint.brave: The model can search the web and read pages (Brave Search, with your key). The queries it sends leave your machine; they are shown in the answer.
